criteria.label: Match between system and the real world
Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors

narrative: A non-default severity-rubric override (F184, CR5-M4): the frequency bucket cut points are shifted more aggressively than F159's shipped default (1=0, 2-3=1, 4-6=2, 7-10=3, 11-plus=4) — a raw within-run re-encounter count of 3 maps to frequency=2 under this config's '3-4' bucket, not frequency=1 under the shipped default's '2-3' bucket, proving the severity scale and the F12/F159/F161/F162 bucket mappings load from the heuristic-set configuration file rather than being hardcoded.
